title: Learner failure implies separation failure
statement: Let $n,\ell,m$ be natural numbers, and let a target function on $\{\pm1\}^n$ have encoded algebraic degree at most $\ell$. The set of sample-input lists on which the learner, trained with labels from the target, fails to evaluate to the encoded target is contained in the set of lists whose encoded inputs do not distinguish all low-degree coefficient families.
hypotheses_covered: natural numbers n, ℓ, and m
target's encoded algebraic degree is at most ℓ
